source: InboundConnectionLimiter (b765b8271). A connection accepted while maxInboundConnections are open is closed at once (reset), counted in mock_server_inbound_connections_rejected and logged at WARN at most every 10 s; a CONNECT tunnel's loopback leg to the server itself is a second connection, so with one slot a CONNECT is answered 502 (InboundConnectionLimitIntegrationTest). After the loopback refusal the limiter's WARN is suppressed (within 10 s of the first) and the relay's 'tunnel connection to:{}closed before the tunnel was established' WARN (RelayConnectHandler.channelInactive) is logged or not, racing the reset (1 of 6 recordings): the log reads after the CONNECT and after a SOCKS4a CONNECT (same relay) mask that one entry away; mock-server serves the tunnel in-process, never logs it, and is the oracle's other outcome. Each step's connection is given time to close before the next, as one slot is all there is. Without metricsEnabled: the recorder polls a metricsEnabled oracle's metrics until it is up, and a poll refused then would be the logged refusal
